# CLI

`deweyou-cli` wires skills, rules, and design contracts from this hub into other local repositories.

```bash
npm install -g deweyou-cli
deweyou-cli agent update
deweyou-cli agent init
deweyou-cli agent doctor
```

Read the package docs in [cli/README.md](https://github.com/deweyou/agents/blob/main/cli/README.md).
